modules.title: Pick your hero
modules.goal: Choose one hero the story can follow.
modules.checkpoint: Can you say who the story follows in one short sentence?

modules.title: Give them a want
modules.goal: Say what the hero wants and what blocks them.
modules.checkpoint: Does the problem make the hero act?

modules.title: Draw four pictures
modules.goal: Plan a beginning, problem, try, and ending.
modules.checkpoint: Does each picture change what happens next?

modules.title: Make one picture move
modules.goal: Choose one clear movement for the biggest moment.
modules.checkpoint: Can you describe the movement with one action word?

modules.title: Read your storybook
modules.goal: Put the pictures and sentences into a book.
modules.checkpoint: Can someone follow the story without an explanation?

modules.title: Set a finish line
modules.goal: Define a film small enough to finish in a weekend.
modules.checkpoint: Is the idea designed for about 60 seconds?

modules.title: Build a story spine
modules.goal: Turn the brief into visible cause and effect.
modules.checkpoint: Does every beat force the next beat?

modules.title: Use critique, not vibes
modules.goal: Read revision notes and connect them to craft.
modules.checkpoint: Can you explain why the revision is clearer?

modules.title: Choose a shot direction
modules.goal: Match mood and purpose to a grounded shot reference.
modules.checkpoint: Does framing support the story beat?

modules.title: Protect continuity
modules.goal: Arrange beats into a coherent 60-second plan.
modules.checkpoint: Can each shot connect clearly to the next?

modules.title: Package the plan
modules.goal: Export a portable production plan with every prompt.
modules.checkpoint: Could another maker run the plan without guessing?

modules.title: Read shot grammar from frames
modules.goal: Name scale, angle, purpose, and evidence from real frames.
modules.checkpoint: Does every label point to visible evidence and a source timecode?

modules.title: Design coverage and continuity
modules.goal: Build coverage that preserves screen direction and editorial options.
modules.checkpoint: Can the scene cut without breaking geography?

modules.title: Justify lens and lighting logic
modules.goal: Match perspective and motivated light across a sequence.
modules.checkpoint: Can you name the source, direction, and continuity risk of the light?

modules.title: Build AI previz
modules.goal: Use AI for shots that are unsafe, costly, or impossible to shoot.
modules.checkpoint: Does the prompt specify observable action instead of aesthetic adjectives alone?

modules.title: Match plates and lighting
modules.goal: Diagnose a plate before planning a synthetic extension.
modules.checkpoint: Do direction, softness, contrast, and palette match the plate?

modules.title: Control temporal consistency
modules.goal: Identify motion and continuity risks before generation.
modules.checkpoint: Are subject, camera, and environmental motions separated?

modules.title: Shape edit rhythm
modules.goal: Use duration and juxtaposition to control attention.
modules.checkpoint: Can you defend every duration by story function?

modules.title: Specify delivery
modules.goal: Package technical assumptions and cited creative choices.
modules.checkpoint: Does every shot choice cite a craft ID and delivery assumption?
modules.output: A cited shot list and previz reel plan
